mapper.select: SELECT b.board_idx AS id, b.board_title AS title, b.board_create_idx AS writer, b.board_create_date AS createdAt, MAX(r.reply_contents) AS answer, ( CASE WHEN COUNT(r.reply_idx) > 0 THEN '답변완료' ELSE '미답변' END ) AS answerStatus FROM tb_board b LEFT JOIN tb_reply r ON b.board_idx = r.reply_board_idx GROUP BY b.board_idx, b.board_title, b.board_create_idx, b.board_create_date ORDER BY b.board_idx DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_board (board_title, board_contents, board_create_idx) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{writer})
mapper.select: SELECT b.board_idx AS id, b.board_title AS title, b.board_contents AS content, b.board_create_idx AS writer, b.board_create_date AS createdAt, b.board_hit_cnt AS cnt, r.reply_contents AS answer, r.reply_create_date AS replyCreatedAt FROM tb_board b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM tb_reply ORDER BY reply_create_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) r ON b.board_idx = r.reply_board_idx WHERE b.board_idx = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_board SET board_hit_cnt = board_hit_cnt + 1 WHERE board_idx = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_reply (reply_contents, reply_board_idx, reply_create_idx) VALUES (#{answer}, #{id}, #{writer})
